# Doctor checks

`pinka doctor` runs these checks in this order. A check that does not apply to the host (no GPU, another node role or provider, no platform yet) is skipped, not passed. A failed check of severity `error` makes doctor exit with 2, a failed `warning` with 1 (see [Exit codes](exit-codes.md)).

| Check | Severity | What it asserts | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preflight.outcome` | error | A fresh read-only preflight still allows the lab on this host. | Run `pinka preflight` and fix what it reports; see the support matrix. [How to fix preflight.outcome](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-preflight-outcome) |
| `preflight.drift` | warning | Outcome, provider and features match /etc/pinka/host-profile.json. | If the change is intended, run bootstrap with --refresh-profile. [How to fix preflight.drift](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-preflight-drift) |
| `services.units` | error | Every unit of pinka-lab.target is active. | `systemctl status UNIT` and `journalctl -u UNIT`; `pinka start`. [How to fix services.units](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-services-units) |
| `services.containers` | error | Lab containers run healthy with their pinned digests. | Run bootstrap again; it recreates containers from the pinned digests. [How to fix services.containers](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-services-containers) |
| `network.listeners` | error | Nothing listens outside loopback except sshd and expected host services. | Stop the listed service or bind it to 127.0.0.1. [How to fix network.listeners](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-listeners) |
| `network.firewall` | error | The lab's firewall and Docker compatibility rules are present. | Run bootstrap with --tags firewall. [How to fix network.firewall](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-firewall) |
| `network.tailscale` | error | Tailscale is logged in with the expected name and tag, Funnel off. | `tailscale up` per the Tailscale how-to; `tailscale funnel reset` removes Funnel. [How to fix network.tailscale](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-tailscale) |
| `gpu.docker` | error | A container of the pinned CUDA image sees the GPU. | Check the driver (`nvidia-smi`) and run bootstrap with --tags nvidia_container_toolkit. [How to fix gpu.docker](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-docker) |
| `gpu.vllm` | error | vLLM answers /health when a deployment is active. | `journalctl -u pinka-inference.service`; reactivate the deployment. [How to fix gpu.vllm](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-vllm) |
| `inference.pairing` | error | Lab and inference nodes: certificate valid, paired with the node the host_vars name. | Pair the nodes and set the peer in host_vars (pair-inference-node how-to). [How to fix inference.pairing](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-inference-pairing) |
| `incus.pool` | warning | The storage pool has the chosen backend and enough free space. | Delete unused instances and images or grow the pool. [How to fix incus.pool](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-pool) |
| `incus.objects` | error | The bench and build projects and the lab's profiles exist. | Run bootstrap with --tags incus. [How to fix incus.objects](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-objects) |
| `incus.certificates` | error | Service client certificates exist, are owned by the service and trusted. | Run bootstrap with --tags incus, or rotate.yml --tags incus. [How to fix incus.certificates](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-certificates) |
| `incus.metrics` | warning | Prometheus scrapes the Incus metrics endpoint. | Check the metrics certificate and the Prometheus target page. [How to fix incus.metrics](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-metrics) |
| `incus.events` | warning | The Incus event feed into the journal runs. | `systemctl restart pinka-incus-events.service`. [How to fix incus.events](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-events) |
| `layout.tree` | error | Lab directories have the layout's owners, modes and default ACLs. | Run bootstrap with --tags layout. [How to fix layout.tree](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-layout-tree) |
| `accounts.groups` | error | No researcher in docker or the Incus admin group; no service account in docker. | `gpasswd -d USER GROUP`, or list the admin in break_glass_docker. [How to fix accounts.groups](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-accounts-groups) |
| `deploy.provenance` | error | No .git in deployed paths; catalog content only in the catalog directory (B2). | Remove the deployment and deploy again from the mirror. [How to fix deploy.provenance](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-deploy-provenance) |
| `systemd.hardening` | error | Platform units carry their hardening (agent runner InaccessiblePaths). | Run bootstrap with --tags platform. [How to fix systemd.hardening](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-systemd-hardening) |
| `sockets.permissions` | error | Platform sockets have the contract's owners, modes and ACLs (C8). | Restart the owning service; run bootstrap with --tags platform. [How to fix sockets.permissions](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-sockets-permissions) |
| `postgres.roles` | error | Roles exist, reader and Grafana cannot read gt, durability is on. | Run bootstrap with --tags postgres. [How to fix postgres.roles](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-postgres-roles) |
| `opa.authz` | error | OPA answers health and rejects policy and data writes (C6). | Run bootstrap with --tags opa. [How to fix opa.authz](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-opa-authz) |
| `telemetry.roundtrip` | error | A probe log, span and metric arrive in Loki, Tempo and Prometheus. | `journalctl -u pinka-observability.service`; check the collector's logs. [How to fix telemetry.roundtrip](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-telemetry-roundtrip) |
| `time.sync` | error | The clock is NTP-synchronized with a small offset. | Check timesyncd or chrony; on WSL run `wsl --shutdown` after resume. [How to fix time.sync](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-time-sync) |
| `backup.recent` | warning | Backups are configured, recent and the repository answers. | Configure the repository (backup how-to) or check `journalctl -u pinka-backup.service`. [How to fix backup.recent](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-backup-recent) |
| `lab.health_gate` | error | The startup health gate passed. | `journalctl -u pinka-health-gate.service`; fix the failing check and `pinka start`. [How to fix lab.health_gate](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-health_gate) |
| `lab.session` | warning | This boot's session record exists and is complete. | `systemctl restart pinka-session-start.service` after fixing the recorded errors. [How to fix lab.session](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-session) |
| `lab.rolling_drift` | warning | On a rolling release, the system matches the session's fingerprint. | Use `pinka update-host` for updates; reports show the fingerprint diff. [How to fix lab.rolling_drift](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-rolling_drift) |
| `resources.cpusets` | warning | Lab services run on cpuset_services, and both CPU sets exist on this host. | Set cpuset_services and cpuset_targets in host_vars to CPUs the host has (on WSL: processors= in .wslconfig) and run bootstrap; then restart the lab (`sudo pinka stop`, `sudo pinka start`) so services move to their CPUs. [How to fix resources.cpusets](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-resources-cpusets) |
| `wsl.config` | warning | WSL: wsl.conf, memory, CPUs and /dev/kvm as expected. | Copy the recommended .wslconfig on Windows and run `wsl --shutdown`. [How to fix wsl.config](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-wsl-config) |

## Smoke checks

`pinka doctor --smoke` adds one check `smoke.<blueprint>` (severity `error`) per golden image blueprint of the lab description. It launches a throwaway target of the newest image in the project `bench` on a fresh run network without NAT, with the run ACL and the telemetry proxy device, and asserts that systemd is running, the blueprint's services are active, a log line tagged with the throwaway run ID reaches Loki, the internet is unreachable, and the lab host does not answer on the lab's ports. The target and its network are deleted afterwards, also on failure. VM blueprints are skipped. See [How to fix a failed doctor check](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-smoke) when one fails.
